title: Referenceable
description: Base class for everything in Atlan.

properties.name: businessAttributes
properties.description: Map of custom metadata attributes and values defined on the asset. (1)

properties.name: createdBy
properties.description: User or account that created the asset.

properties.name: updatedBy
properties.description: User or account that last updated the asset.

properties.name: createTime
properties.description: Time (epoch) at which the asset was created, in milliseconds.

properties.name: updateTime
properties.description: Time (epoch) at which the asset was last updated, in milliseconds.

properties.name: deleteHandler
properties.description: Details on the handler used for deletion of the asset. (1)

properties.name: classificationNames
properties.description: Hashed-string names of the Atlan tags that exist on the asset. (1)

properties.name: meaningNames
properties.description: Human-readable names of terms that have been linked to this asset.

properties.name: meanings
properties.description: Details of terms that have been linked to this asset. (1)

properties.name: pendingTasks
properties.description: Unique identifiers (GUIDs) for any background tasks that are yet to operate on this asset.

properties.name: qualifiedName
properties.description: Unique name for this asset. This is typically a concatenation of the asset's name onto its parent's qualifiedName. This must be unique across all assets of the same type.
